_comment: J19: maps each journey named in unierp-workspace/docs/ai/APP_FLOW.md to the real, existing e2e/journeys/*.spec.ts file(s) that test it. A journey with an empty specs array is documented but NOT YET TESTED - a real, named gap, not silently implied covered. crossCuttingSpecs allowlists specs that test an APP_FLOW.md section 11 behavioural rule (tenant isolation, RBAC boundary, offboarding) rather than one of the 7 named journeys - real, valuable tests that are not 'a journey' in this doc's own taxonomy, so they are not force-mapped to one.

A.title: Onboarding a new organisation (Dev, IT Admin)
A.gap: No E2E test exists for tenant sign-up / initial org setup.

B.title: Daily sign-in
B.note: Covers the plain email/password success and 401 (no-account-disclosure) outcomes only. The documented MFA, OAuth/SSO, account-lockout, and forgot-password branches are NOT covered - a real, named partial gap (see D140), not implied fully covered.

C.title: The universal record lifecycle
C.note: Each of these is a concrete, module-specific instance of the C1-C4 pattern (list/detail/create-edit/state-machine) rather than a generic test of the pattern itself. Real coverage, not a gap, but worth naming explicitly rather than leaving the mapping implicit.

D.title: Approval workflow
D.gap: No E2E test exercises a generic approval chain (submit, approve, reject, escalate) end to end.

E.title: Frontline mobile (Sam)
E.reason: This is a WEB e2e suite (Playwright against the Next.js web client) - a mobile journey cannot be tested here at all. Needs its own coverage in unierp-mobile.

F.title: AI Copilot
F.gap: No E2E test exercises the AI copilot journey.

G.title: Extending without forking (Ravi, partner)
G.note: "create and verify a custom entity" via the builder is a real, direct match for this journey.

crossCuttingSpecs.tenant-isolation.spec.ts: Tests APP_FLOW.md § 11 'Tenant-safe by construction' directly, not a named journey.
crossCuttingSpecs.plane-2-boundary.spec.ts: Tests the RBAC/plane-2 admin boundary, a security control not a user journey.
crossCuttingSpecs.user-lifecycle.spec.ts: Tests offboarding/session-revocation, a lifecycle/security guarantee, not one of the 7 named journeys.
